newsitem.title: FRENCH GUIANA: One killed, seven injured in French Guiana riots.
newsitem.headline: One killed, seven injured in French Guiana riots.

text.p: One man has died and seven have been injured in two days of rioting in French Guiana, officials said on Sunday.
The extensively burned body of a man was discovered in a looted shop in the capital Cayenne. An autopsy is to be performed to identify the victim.
Officials said a total of seven people have also been injured in the rioting, including six police, in the French overseas territory on the northeast coast of South America.

The riots were sparked by a strike of high school students demanding better conditions in local schools. They barricaded French officials in the Cayenne Prefecture building for several hours on Thursday and were disbursed when police charged the building and fired teargas.
On Saturday the first contingent of 200 military police reinforcements began to arrive from Paris. The city of 35,000 is now heavily patrolled in anticipation of fresh violence.

French Guiana is the only non-independent territory in South America. Its economy lags behind mainland France and it has an unemployment rate approaching 25 percent of the labour force. Joblessness is particularly acute among the young.
